map.不能，仅作受压点初评提示，正式记录仍按医院压疮评估量表（如 Braden）与术中: No, it only gives an initial indication of pressure points; the formal record still follows the hospital pressure ulcer assessment scale (such as Braden) and the intraoperative nursing sheet.
map.以床旁实际观察为准，工具结果为参考阈值，皮肤苍白或潮红明显时应立即减压并延长观察: Defer to actual bedside observation; the tool result is a reference threshold. If the skin is clearly pale or flushed, relieve pressure immediately and extend observation.
map.全身麻醉俯卧位或侧卧位手术前，依据受压点分布初评压红与缺血风险，决定硅胶垫与足跟: Before prone or lateral surgery under general anaesthesia, do an initial assessment of pressure redness and ischaemia risk from the pressure point distribution to decide on silicone pad placement and heel suspension.

map.肥胖或低蛋白血症患者，结合 BMI 与营养状态上调风险等级，缩短减压间隔。: For obese or hypoalbuminaemic patients, raise the risk level based on BMI and nutritional status and shorten the pressure relief interval.
map.脊柱、肛肠等长时间固定体位手术，按手术时长分段标注高危骨突，提醒术中定时减压。: For long operations in a fixed position such as spinal or anorectal surgery, mark the high-risk bony prominences by operative duration segment and remind the team to relieve pressure on schedule.
map.输入手术体位、时长与患者因素，评估骨突部位压力性损伤风险等级并输出预警，用于术中: Enter the surgical position, duration and patient factors to assess the risk level of pressure injury at bony prominences and output warnings, for intraoperative positioning care and protective measures.
